name: io.github.Servosity/autotask-mcp
title: Autotask MCP
description: Every Autotask entity at the command line, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers ticket-aging

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_API_INTEGRATION_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Sets AUTOTASK_API_INTEGRATION_CODE for the Autotask PSA MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Autotask PSA API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_PSA_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the AUTOTASK_PSA_SECRET credential for the Autotask MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_PSA_USER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Set the AUTOTASK_PSA_USER_NAME credential for the Autotask MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any tool that changes Autotask. Leave blank to keep every tool (each write still previews and acts only with confirm: true).

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOTASK_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Autotask requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
